source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 744 removes the badge clear from the branch for an already shown or open application menu. That branch dismisses doorhangers and updates the banner, while the focused-window branch and the no-notifications branch still have their own clear behavior. Do not fix badge persistence by removing every clear call. This establishes separate banner, doorhanger and badge state, without a live notification or accessibility announcement check.
title: Keep an update badge independent of the open application menu
